1.content: Build Node.js enrichment pipeline that fetches live data from CoinGecko, DefiLlama, GitHub, TokenUnlocks APIs and persists to projects_enriched.json
1.details:
1. Read existing projects.json (349 entries)
2. Build async fetcher with rate limiting (CoinGecko 10-30 req/min, GitHub 60/hr, DefiLlama 60/min)
3. For each project: fetch CoinGecko market data, GitHub repo stats, DefiLlama TVL (if DeFi), Token Unlocks
4. Save enriched data to /workspace/public/data/projects_enriched.json
5. Estimated runtime: 30-60 minutes for 336 projects

2.content: Update data adapter to read enriched data and populate all V1 fields
2.details:
1. Modify intelligence-data.js to load projects_enriched.json
2. Map enriched fields: market_cap, tvl, github stars/commits, next unlock, etc.
3. Ensure all V1 renderer fields are populated when data exists

3.content: Compute AI scores (PAYD, Conviction, Alpha, Risk) from enriched data
3.details:
1. Use existing PaydScoreEngine, PaydConvictionEngine, PaydAlphaEngine
2. Compute scores algorithmically from market cap, TVL, GitHub activity, unlocks
3. Save to projects_scores.json
4. Update data adapter to load scores

4.content: Generate fundamental research data (team, investors, partnerships, roadmap, etc.)
4.details:
1. Use research.json (existing) + web research
2. Generate AI Investment Opinion, Bull/Bear cases algorithmically from data
3. Add advantages/risks based on metrics
4. Save to projects_research.json

5.content: Expand RWA sector with leading verified projects (Ondo, Maker, Centrifuge, Maple, Goldfinch, Clearpool, Plume, OpenEden, Backed, Hashnote, Securitize)
5.details:
1. Add ~15 new RWA projects to projects.json
2. Include all required fields: coingeckoId, githubOrg, website, description
3. These projects will be enriched by the same pipeline

6.details:
1. Run test-render-all.js to verify no crashes
2. Spot-check 20 random projects: market metrics, protocol metrics, GitHub, tokenomics, AI scores, research
3. Confirm Unavailable fields only when data truly doesn't exist

7.details:
1. Deploy with all enriched data
2. Visit site and verify metrics display correctly
3. Hard refresh may be required
